stories.title: Ontario Liberals to name new leader after weeks of voting, months of campaigning
stories.summary: TORONTO - Ontario Liberals are getting ready to name their new party leader, with results from members' ranked ballots set to be revealed later today.
stories.detail: Ontario Liberals will choose their new leader today as the once dominant party makes its latest attempt to escape the political wilderness and insiders say no "runaway winner" has emerged over the course of the lenghty race.

details.summary: TORONTO - Ontario Liberals are getting ready to name their new party leader, with results from members' ranked ballots set to be revealed later today.

Ontario Liberals will choose their new leader today as the once dominant party makes its latest attempt to escape the political wilderness and insiders say no "runaway winner" has emerged over the course of the lenghty race.
Ontario's Liberal Party will wrap up a long leadership race Saturday, and, they hope, an even longer stretch without a long-term leader.

stories.title: Fossil fuel talks deadlock pushes COP31 climate summit into overtime
stories.summary: EU warns COP31 risks turning into a 'fossil summit' as critical climate commitments are omitted from the draft deal.
stories.detail: African ministers say they ‘didn’t come here to beg’, with civil society groups calling it the ‘worst Cop ever’ Crucial climate talks headed into overtime on the last official day of the Cop31 UN summit as countries continued to argue over a draft deal that was silent on fossil fuels, with a host of other contentious issues complicating negotiations. Nearly 200 countries struggled to bridge their differences after two weeks of intense talks and impassioned speeches in Antalya, Turkey, about the effects of climate breakdown around the world, with a scheduled finish of Friday evening breached.

details.summary: EU warns COP31 risks turning into a 'fossil summit' as critical climate commitments are omitted from the draft deal.

stories.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad
stories.summary: U.S. tech companies that build artificial intelligence data centers in other countries will face "a tremendous tax," President Donald Trump said on Friday.
stories.detail: President gives wide-ranging White House press conference and says he has ‘fantastic relationships’ with Putin and Xi Donald Trump threatened on Friday to impose “tremendous penalties” on American tech companies that build datacenters outside the US, though he gave no details and told reporters he had not yet informed his own officials about the plan. In a discursive press conference from the White House briefing room, Trump also said he would “look into” the report that Iran had been planning to possibly detonate a “dirty bomb” in Washington DC, and backed JD Vance over comments the vice-president made blaming Republican midterm losses on the Iran war.

details.summary: U.S. tech companies that build artificial intelligence data centers in other countries will face "a tremendous tax," President Donald Trump said on Friday.
